original: trīniṣūnayomayānupakalpayasva | caturthamiṣuṃ yameva kaṃcanāniyamena kalpayasveti pratidhatsva kāṇḍadhanuṣīti brūyāt | pratidadhānaṃ rājānamanumantrayeta vaiṇāvatāyeti dhārayātretyantena | sahasā tiṣṭheti ca brūyāt | rājā ca dhanuṣaḥ kāṇḍamanupanīyānuyāyināmanyatamaṃ rathamātiṣṭhet |
analyzed: trīn iṣūn ayaḥ mayān upakalpayasva caturtham iṣum yam eva kaṃcana aniyamena kalpayasva iti pratidhatsva kāṇḍadhanuṣi iti brūyāt pratidadhānam rājānam anumantrayeta vaiṇāvatāya iti dhāraya atra ityantena sahasā tiṣṭha iti ca brūyāt rājā ca dhanuṣaḥ kāṇḍam an upanīya anuyāyinām anyatamam ratham ātiṣṭhet

original: yajamānaparicārakā uttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ pūrvāpare carmaṇī vibadhnīyuḥ | dakṣiṇena rathapathaṃ śiṣṭvā | athodgātā rājānaṃ brūyāt | pradakṣiṇaṃ devayajanaṃ parīyādityādi visrambhayeyurityantam | tasyārthaḥ | devayajanaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ parigacchanneva carmaṇoḥ pūrvaṃ carmāgamaneṣu vidhyet |
analyzed: yajamāna paricārakāḥ uttareṇa āgnīdhrīyam pūrva apare carmaṇī vibadhnīyuḥ dakṣiṇena ratha patham śiṣṭvā atha udgātā rājānam brūyāt pradakṣiṇam devayajanam parīyāt ityādi visrambhayeyuḥ ityantam tasya arthaḥ devayajanam pradakṣiṇam parigacchan eva carmaṇoḥ pūrvam carma āgamaneṣu vidhyet

original: kathamekaikenāyomayeneṣuṇottarottaram prathamasyopari dvitīyam tasyopari tṛtīyam anatipātayan atiśayapatanamakurvan aparasmai carmaṇe sacivāya yathāsaukaryamasyeyuḥ | tṛtīyeneṣuṇā vidhyodaṅ prayāyāḥ sacivaiḥ saha | tathā caturthamiṣuṃ yāṃ diśaṃ manyethāstāṃ pratyasyerava brahmadviṣo jahīti | gāṃ dṛṣṭvā avatiṣṭhethāḥ |
analyzed: katham ekaikena ayaḥ mayena iṣuṇā uttarottaram prathamasya upari dvitīyam tasya upari tṛtīyam an atipātayan atiśaya patanam akurvan aparasmai carmaṇe sacivāya yathā saukaryam asyeyuḥ tṛtīyena iṣuṇā vidhya udaṅ prayāyāḥ sacivaiḥ saha tathā caturtham iṣum yām diśam manyethāḥ tām pratyasyeḥ ava brahma dviṣaḥ jahi iti gām dṛṣṭvā avatiṣṭhethāḥ

original: tatra kvāpi gataḥ saṃnāhaṃ kuryuriti | tato'nyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pratipradakṣiṇaṃ devayajanaṃ parīyādityādi praiṣārthaḥ | hiṃkāravelāyāmimaṃ rājānaṃ kārayetyuktvā udgātā bhūmidundubhimāvrajet | paścādāgnīdhrīyasya śvabhraṃ
analyzed: tatra kvāpi gataḥ saṃnāham kuryuḥ iti tatonyam brāhmaṇam pratipradakṣiṇam devayajanam parīyāt ityādi praiṣa arthaḥ hiṃkāra velāyām imam rājānam kāraya iti uktvā udgātā bhūmidundubhim āvrajet paścāt āgnīdhrīyasya śvabhram

original: gavāmayanammahāvratam
analyzed: gavāmayanam mahāvratam

original: dundubhyākṛtikamardhamantarvedi ardhaṃ bahirvedi khātaṃ bhavati | sa bhūmidundubhiḥ ārṣabheṇottaralomnā carmaṇā ācchāditaḥ syāt | taṃ ca tvaṃ vāgasītyādistribhiḥ mantraiḥ pratimantramudgātāro valadhānenāhanyuḥ | anyaṃ vā ghnantametairmantrairanumantrayeran |

original: aikāhikavrate āhīnikavrate ca tvaṃ vāgasītyādimantre satraśabdasthāne yajñaśabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ | yajñe anandiṣuriti anumantryāpa upaspṛśya yathaitaṃ pratyāvṛjya paścāttiṣṭhantaścityamagnimupatiṣṭherana | namaste gāyatryādinā śiraḥ;
analyzed: aikāhika vrate āhīnika vrate ca tvam vāc asi ityādi mantre satra śabda sthāne yajña śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ yajñe anandiṣuḥ iti anumantrya apaḥ upaspṛśya yathaitam pratyāvṛjya paścāt tiṣṭhantaḥ cityam agnim upatiṣṭherana namaḥ te gāyatryādinā śiraḥ

original: namaste rathantarāyeti dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣam, namaste yajñāyajñīyāyetyādinā puccham, namasta vāmadevyāyetyādinā madhyam upatiṣṭheran | brāhmaṇe pakṣāntaratvena yajñāyajñīyaṃ pucchaṃ vāmadevyaṃ cātmā vihitamiti talliṅgābhyāṃ mantrābhyāṃ pucchamadhyayorupasthānam |
analyzed: namaḥ te rathantarāya iti dakṣiṇam pakṣam namaḥ te yajñāyajñīyāya ityādinā puccham namaḥ te vāmadevyāya ityādinā madhyam upatiṣṭheran brāhmaṇe pakṣa antara tvena yajñāyajñīyam puccham vāmadevyam ca ātmā vihitam iti tad liṅgābhyām mantrābhyām puccha madhyayoḥ upasthānam

original: sūtrakāreṇoktamyadā tu bhadrarājane pucchātmane tadā namaste bhadrāyeti pucchaṃ namaste rājanāyeti madhyaṃ copatiṣṭheran | atha sarvamagniṃ namaste gāyatrāyetyādi madhyamityantama | tena samastena mantreṇa tasmai ta iti dhehītyantenopasthāya sadaḥ praviśeyuḥ |
analyzed: sūtra kāreṇa uktam yadā tu bhadra rājane puccha ātmane tadā namaḥ te bhadrāya iti puccham namaḥ te rājanāya iti madhyam ca upatiṣṭheran atha sarvam agnim namaḥ te gāyatrāya ityādi madhyam ityantam a tena samastena mantreṇa tasmai te iti dhehi ityantena upasthāya sadaḥ praviśeyuḥ

original: tatra sarve sahartvijo mahāvratena stuvīran iti brāhmaṇenokte vihṛtya stavanapakṣe agnyupasthānānantaramava sadaḥpraveśa | tasmin hi pakṣe sadasyeva śiraḥprabhṛtibhiḥ sarvaiḥ stavanam | udgātaiva sarveṇodgāyedityasmiṃstu pakṣe havirdhāne śirasā stutvetyādikrameṇa sadaḥ praviśeyu | tatrāyaṃ prayogaḥ | śiraḥpakṣapucchānāṃ bhedena kuśāvidhānam |
analyzed: tatra sarve saha ṛtvijaḥ mahāvratena stuvīran iti brāhmaṇena ukte vihṛtya stavana pakṣe agnyupasthāna anantaram ava sadaḥ praveśa tasmin hi pakṣe sadasi eva śiraḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ sarvaiḥ stavanam udgātā eva sarveṇa udgāyet iti asmin tu pakṣe havirdhāne śirasā stutvā ityādi krameṇa sadaḥ praviśeyu tatra ayam prayogaḥ śiraḥ pakṣa pucchānām bhedena kuśa avidhānam

original: kuśāvidhānavasanāni ca bhinnāni bhinnāni | agnyupasthānaṃ kṛtvā havirdhānasya pūrvayā dvārā prapadya havirdhānamadhye somapātrāṇāmuttarataḥ indramidgāthino bṛhad indro dadhīco asthabhir udghedabhi śrutāmaghamiti
analyzed: kuśa vidhāna vasanāni ca bhinnāni bhinnāni agnyupasthānam kṛtvā havirdhānasya pūrvayā dvārā prapadya havirdhāna madhye soma pātrāṇām uttaratas indram id gāthinaḥ bṛhat indraḥ dadhīcaḥ asthabhiḥ udghā id abhi śrutāmagham iti

original: gāyatreṇāniruktena trivṛtstomena stuvīran | indramidgā caturṛce antyāyā uddhāraḥ | saṃdhiṣāmavatparivartinyā viṣṭutyā kuśāvidhānam | gāyatrādīnāṃ śiraḥprabhṛtisaṃjñayā pakṣirūpaṃ varṇayati śrutiḥ | śiraḥsaṃjñakasya gāyatrasya puṣkalo gāyatrīndra ityṛṣyādayaḥ | yajamānavācanam | acchidrajapāśca rājanena stute sarveṣāṃ tantreṇa kartavyam |
analyzed: gāyatreṇa aniruktena trivṛt stomena stuvīran indram id gā caturṛce antyāyāḥ uddhāraḥ saṃdhiṣāma vat parivartinyā viṣṭutyā kuśa avidhānam gāyatra ādīnām śiraḥ prabhṛti saṃjñayā pakṣi rūpam varṇayati śrutiḥ śiraḥ saṃjñakasya gāyatrasya puṣkalaḥ gāyatrī indraḥ iti ṛṣi ādayaḥ yajamāna vācanam acchidra japāḥ ca rājanena stute sarveṣām tantreṇa kartavyam

original: na tu tattatstyutyanantaram | evaṃ havirdhāne śirasā stutvā saṃrabdhāḥ pratyañca eyuraparayā dvārā | te dakṣiṇena mārjālīyadhiṣṇyaṃ parītya paścānmaitrāvaruṇadhiṣṇyasyopaviśya rathantareṇa pañcadaśena stuvīran | stutvā varacodanā |
analyzed: na tu tat tat styuti anantaram evam havirdhāne śirasā stutvā saṃrabdhāḥ pratyañcaḥ eyuḥ aparayā dvārā te dakṣiṇena mārjālīya dhiṣṇyam parītya paścāt maitrāvaruṇa dhiṣṇyasya upaviśya rathantareṇa pañcadaśena stuvīran stutvā vara codanā

original: tathā copagranthaḥakevalastotre vai khalu bṛhadrathantare vrate dharmāllabheteteti udañcaḥ sarpeyurjaghanena hoturdhiṣṇyam paścādbrāhmaṇācchaṃsino dhiṣṇyasyopaviśya bṛhatā saptadaśena stuvīran |
analyzed: tathā ca upagranthaḥ a kevala stotre vai khalu bṛhat rathantare vrate dharmān labheta ita iti udañcaḥ sarpeyuḥ jaghanena hotuḥ dhiṣṇyam paścāt brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ dhiṣṇyasya upaviśya bṛhatā saptadaśena stuvīran

original: te yenaiva prasarpeyustena punaḥ niḥsṛpya havirdhānasya pūrvayā dvārā niṣkramyottareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ parītya paścādgārhapatyasyopaviśya pucchenaikaviṃśena stuvīran | ekaviṃśaṃ bhadraṃ pucchamiti | bhadreṇa stavanam | te yenaiva nisarpeyuḥ tena punaḥ prasṛpyottareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ parītya havirdhānasya pūrvayā dvārā prapadya saṃrabdhāḥ pratyañca eyuḥ |
analyzed: te yena eva prasarpeyuḥ tena punar niḥsṛpya havirdhānasya pūrvayā dvārā niṣkramya uttareṇa āgnīdhrīyam parītya paścāt gārhapatyasya upaviśya pucchena ekaviṃśena stuvīran ekaviṃśam bhadram puccham iti bhadreṇa stavanam te yena eva nisarpeyuḥ tena punar prasṛpya uttareṇa āgnīdhrīyam parītya havirdhānasya pūrvayā dvārā prapadya saṃrabdhāḥ pratyañcaḥ eyuḥ

analyzed: te dakṣiṇena dhiṣṇyān parītya

original: gavāmayanam mahāvṛtam paścānmaitrāvaruṇasya dhiṣṇyaṃ gatvā yathāyātamupaviśeyuḥ | athāparayā dvāraudumbarīmāsandīṃ mauñjena pūrvaṃ kṛtabandhanāṃ sadasi praviśeyuḥ
analyzed: gavāmayanam mahāvṛtam paścāt maitrāvaruṇasya dhiṣṇyam gatvā yathāyātam upaviśeyuḥ atha aparayā dvār audumbarīm āsandīm mauñjena pūrvam kṛta bandhanām sadasi praviśeyuḥ

original: yajamānaparicārakā. | udumbarābhāve yajñiyasya vṛkṣasya palāśavyatiriktasyāsandī kartavyā | muñjābhāve darbharaśanayā vā bandhanaṃ kartavyam | āsandyāḥ prādeśamātrāḥ pādāḥ kāryāḥ | aratnimātrāṇītarāṇyaṅgāni | evaṃbhūtāmāsandīṃ dakṣiṇenaudumbarīṃ hṛtvā tasyā uttarato nidadhyuḥ |
analyzed: yajamāna paricārakāḥ udumbara abhāve yajñiyasya vṛkṣasya palāśa vyatiriktasya āsandī kartavyā muñja abhāve darbha raśanayā vā bandhanam kartavyam āsandyāḥ prādeśa mātrāḥ pādāḥ kāryāḥ aratni mātrāṇi itarāṇi aṅgāni evaṃbhūtām āsandīm dakṣiṇena audumbarīm hṛtvā tasyāḥ uttaratas nidadhyuḥ

original: tāmuttareṇodgātā gatvā paścādupaviśya bhūmispṛśo'syāḥ pādān kṛtvā kūrcāvadhastādupohyābhimṛśet | bṛhadrathantare te pūrvau pādāviti pūrvapādadvayam | śyaitanaudhase aparau | vairūpavairāje anūcī iti prācīnaphalakadvayam | śākvararaivate tiraścī ityudīcīnaphalakadvayam | evaṃ pṛthagaṅgānyabhimṛśya vivayanaṃ mauñjarajjubhirbandhanam |
analyzed: tām uttareṇa udgātā gatvā paścāt upaviśya bhūmi spṛśaḥ asyāḥ pādān kṛtvā kūrcau adhastāt upohya abhimṛśet bṛhat rathantare te pūrvau pādau iti pūrva pāda dvayam śyaita naudhase aparau vairūpa vairāje anūcī iti prācīna phalaka dvayam śākvara raivate tiraścī iti udīcīna phalaka dvayam evam pṛthak aṅgāni abhimṛśya vivayanam mauñja rajjubhiḥ bandhanam

original: ālabhya japedṛcaḥ | prāñca ā tā nā iti yajñāyajñīyamityantam | tatra vivayanānāṃ yathāliṅgamālambhaḥ kāryaḥ | tāmāsandīmukhenorasā bāhubhyāṃ ca spṛṣṭvārohet | vasavastvetyādibhiścaturbhirmantraiḥ sāmrājyāyetyantairārohaṇam | āruhya japet | syonāmāsadaṃ sukhadāmāsadaṃ namaste'stu mā mā hiṃsāriti |
analyzed: ālabhya japet ṛcaḥ prāñcaḥ ā tā naḥ iti yajñāyajñīyam ityantam tatra vivayanānām yathāliṅgam ālambhaḥ kāryaḥ tām āsandī mukhena urasā bāhubhyām ca spṛṣṭvā ārohet vasavaḥ tvā ityādibhiḥ caturbhiḥ mantraiḥ sāmrājyāya iti antaiḥ ārohaṇam āruhya japet syonām āsadam sukha dām āsadam namaḥ te tu mā mā hiṃsāḥ iti

original: evamārohatyudgātari prastotṛpratihartārau brahmā ca gṛhapatiścāhīnapakṣe satre sarve kūrcānāroheyuḥ | āsandyā vyākhyātaṃ dravyaṃ vāṇasya | vāṇaśabdena vīṇāviśeṣa ucyate | sa udumbarasya yajñiyavṛkṣasya vā kartavyaḥ | tasya
analyzed: evam ārohati udgātari prastotṛ pratihartārau brahmā ca gṛhapatiḥ ca ahīnapakṣe satre sarve kūrcān āroheyuḥ āsandyāḥ vyākhyātam dravyam vāṇasya vāṇa śabdena vīṇā viśeṣaḥ ucyate saḥ udumbarasya yajñiya vṛkṣasya vā kartavyaḥ tasya

original: daṇḍasyādhastādbhāge parimaṇḍalākāraṃ daṇḍaparimāṇāt sthaviṣṭhaṃ vakrarūpaṃ bilaṃ bhavati | tasmin pradeśe lohitenānaḍuhenottaralomnā carmaṇā pracchādito bhavati | tasyopari bhāge daśa chidrāṇi bhavanti | teṣūparyupari daśa tantryo baddhāḥ syuḥ mauñjyo dārbhyo vā | yadvā | daśānāmapi chidrāṇāṃ madhye śatatantryo baddhāḥ syuḥ | katham |
analyzed: daṇḍasya adhastāt bhāge parimaṇḍala ākāram daṇḍa parimāṇāt sthaviṣṭham vakra rūpam bilam bhavati tasmin pradeśe lohitena ānaḍuhena uttara lomnā carmaṇā pracchāditaḥ bhavati tasya upari bhāge daśa chidrāṇi bhavanti teṣu upari upari daśa tantryaḥ baddhāḥ syuḥ mauñjyaḥ dārbhyaḥ vā yat vā daśānām api chidrāṇām madhye śata tantryaḥ baddhāḥ syuḥ katham

original: catustriṃśanmadhyame | trayastriṃśāvabhitaḥ | tadagre tvekaikaśo bandhanaṃ kartavyam | tāstraidhaṃ vibhajya bhūrbhuvaḥsvarityekaikayā vyāhṛtyottarottarayodūhet | bhūriti trayastriṃśatamudūhet | bhuvariti catustriṃśatamudūhet | svariti trayastriṃśatamudūhet | etaccodūhanaṃ pakṣadvaye'pi kāryam | taṃ vāṇamabhimṛśet | vadovadeti vāṇetyantena |
analyzed: catustriṃśat madhyame trayastriṃśau abhitas tad agre tu ekaikaśas bandhanam kartavyam tāḥ traidham vibhajya bhūḥ bhuvaḥ svar iti ekaikayā vyāhṛtya uttarottarayā udūhet bhūḥ iti trayastriṃśatam udūhet bhuvar iti catustriṃśatam udūhet svar iti trayastriṃśatam udūhet etat ca udūhanam pakṣa dvaye api kāryam tam vāṇam abhimṛśet vadaḥ vada iti vāṇa ityantena

original: śithilāṃstantūnāyacchet | ebhirno vāṇetyaśīmahītyantena | vāk sarvaṃ mano jyotirmano bhadra iti japitvā vāṇamindraṇatayeṣikayā vetasaśākhayā ca sapalāśayā mūladeśe vādayet | yā svayaṃ vakrā sendraṇatā | prāṇāya tvetyūrdhvamullikhet | apānāya tvetyavāñcamavalikhet | vyānāya tvā vyānāya tveti triḥsaṃlikhyodañcaṃ vāṇaṃ prohet |
analyzed: śithilān tantūn āyacchet ebhiḥ naḥ vāṇa iti aśīmahi ityantena vāc sarvam manaḥ jyotiḥ manaḥ bhadraḥ iti japitvā vāṇam indraṇatayā iṣikayā vetasa śākhayā ca sa palāśayā mūla deśe vādayet yā svayam vakrā sa indraṇatā prāṇāya tvā iti ūrdhvam ullikhet apānāya tvā iti avāñcam avalikhet vyānāya tvā vyānāya tvā iti tris saṃlikhya udañcam vāṇam prohet

original: imaṃ vāṇamullikhannāsveti brāhmaṇamuktvā āhatadundubhīn pravadantu | vīṇā iti brūyāt | alābuvīṇāṃ vakrākapiśīrṇyau ca pūrvasyāṃ dvāri bahissadasaṃ vīṇāvādino vādayeyuḥ |
